title: Check your loyalty points
lead: Enter the phone number you use with {shop}. We send a 6-digit code to your chat with the shop (Zalo or Telegram), not by SMS.
sentBody: If this number is a member and chats with the shop on Zalo or Telegram, the code is there now. It works for 10 minutes. No message? Ask the shop staff.
redeemHint: To redeem, tell the shop in your chat or at the counter.
noRewards: The shop has not listed rewards yet.
